About The Brand Hub

Pioneering Intelligent Spatial Systems

GeoAI CON is the leading international platform dedicated to the convergence of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and Artificial Intelligence.

Our Core Mission

To drive innovation in spatial data science, earth observation, and intelligent mapping through collaborative research and scalable deployment across domains.

Global Impact

Establishing technical standards, publishing peer-reviewed execution models, and connecting a decentralized network of working GeoAI professionals worldwide.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is GeoAI CON?

GeoAI CON is the premier international conference dedicated to the convergence of Geospatial Information Systems (GIS) and Artificial Intelligence. It brings together researchers, industry leaders, and policymakers to discuss the latest advancements in spatial AI.

When is the next GeoAI CON?

The next edition, GeoAI CON 2026, is scheduled for December 2026. Stay tuned for official announcements regarding the exact dates and venue.

How can I partner with GeoAI CON?

We offer various partnership opportunities for academic institutions, tech companies, and government organizations. You can reach out to us via the "Partner with us" button in the navigation bar.

Are past conference recordings available?

Yes, retrospectives and select recordings from past editions like GeoAI CON 2025 are available through our archives and dedicated portal links on this site.

Shape the future of intelligent mapping

Sponsorships and institutional partnerships for the 2026 edition are now open. Collaborate directly with the foremost authorities in Geospatial AI.
